# Forum debate: Reborn Krayt vs Vitiate (Suspect Insight)

**URL:** https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t619-reborn-krayt-vs-vitiate (page 2 at `/t619p25-reborn-krayt-vs-vitiate`)
**Pages read:** 2 of 2 (29 posts). Raw: `forum-raw/t619_pg1..2.html`, `t619.c.txt`.

## Conditions
Reborn (Legacy-era) Krayt vs Vitiate as of the Revan novel throne-room fight.

## Arguments for VITIATE
- **AncientPower's chain** (see below), anchored on Muur → Malak. He quotes Ajunta Pall: "We were not the first to fall to the dark side. But we had more power than those before us... So much power, it is blinding". He quotes the Rakatan computer: "Only one who is immensely strong in mind can harness the power of the Star Forge". Malak drove the Forge to 300%.
- **The Lost / ILS (rebutting Krayt-side scaling):**
  - Krayt was weakened in Vector.
  - Celeste-Muur > Muur alone, so the Muur-Krayt comparison overrates Krayt.
  - The double nexus amped Vitiate.
  - Links SI t14 (the Tyrannical Ten debate) for background. We did not read t14.
- **IG:** the SWTOR Jedi Knight-storyline Vitiate is weaker than the novel version, so the novel version should be used.
- Also for Vitiate: Guest ("good fight"), DC77, Geistalt.

## Arguments for KRAYT
- **PeraltaEagle45**, from the Revan novel: "Revan could have defeated Vitiate that day had the distance... not been so great". So Vitiate's showing in the throne room was beatable.
- **LSDMB:** Legacy-era Muur had about 150 more years of development, so the Muur scaling cuts the other way.
- Also for Krayt: Master Azronger, HellfireUnit, HeartoftheForce, Deronn_Solo ("10/10").

## Counterarguments and rebuttals that seemed to land
- "Krayt struggled with Muur" → Krayt was weakened in Vector, and the Muur he faced was Celeste-Muur (The Lost/ILS). **Landed** with the Vitiate camp. It weakens the Muur-based downscale of Krayt, which hurts AncientPower's chain on its own terms.
- "Revan nearly beat Vitiate" (PeraltaEagle45) → the Vitiate side answers that Vitiate was in the double nexus *and* fighting two opponents. **Contested.**

## Verdict tally (POSTER OPINION)
Vitiate 5 (Guest, DC77, AncientPower, Geistalt, IG). Krayt 5 (PeraltaEagle45, Master Azronger, HellfireUnit, HeartoftheForce, Deronn_Solo). **Split 5-5.**

## Scaling chains used
- AncientPower: **Vitiate >> Masked Revan > Pre-Masked Revan >> SF!Revan > SF!Malak >>>>> the Exiles.** Muur is far below SF Malak (Star Map vs Star Forge), and Krayt struggled with Muur, so Krayt << Vitiate.
- The Lost/ILS: Celeste-Muur > Muur alone. Weakened Krayt ≠ peak Krayt.

## Conflicts with our notes
- **Supported in direction:** Krayt learned essence transfer from Andeddu and Muur (`krayt-legends-quotes.txt`). Vitiate "infinitely more powerful than Darth Nyriss" (`vitiate-comicvine-respect-part1.txt`).
- **Not in our notes:** the Ajunta Pall and Rakatan-computer quotes, Malak's "300%" figure, the "distance... not been so great" Revan novel line, and Muur's extra 150 years.
